analysis:
Integration pass over 28 units from a PR that widens the CBv2 mixed-step prefill geometry. The wide geometry is a 2,048-token chunk with a 4,096-token step, for GPT-OSS, dense Qwen3.5/3.8 and Gemma 4 text. Bidirectional media keeps a 512 ceiling. Adds the DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS overrides, forwarded through LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys. Bumps the benchmark schema to v5, updates tests, scripts and docs, and bumps the libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule pointer. The replayed source is documentation, patches and test excerpts only; the production Swift code (EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift, LaunchAgent.swift, SchedulerV2) is only partly visible through unit analyses. I cannot verify its source. I found no supported finding.

Checked against the threat model:
- T-041 prefix cache: no change to HMAC lookup tags, the 30-minute TTL, cacheSalt scoping, DBK3 crypto or the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate. Dense Qwen durable checkpoints become coarser, at 2,048 boundaries. That reduces at-rest donations, and the SEC-035 oracle is unchanged in kind.
- The new env keys are non-secret scheduler tuning. They are operator-controlled inside the TB-003 adversary model. The tests show the allowlist stays narrow, with UNRELATED_SECRET excluded and the watchdog passthrough not carrying them.
- Attestation, App Attest authorization, the coordinator WebSocket, key custody and the fan helper are untouched.
- Docs acknowledge the memory risk: GPT-OSS peak is 0.1 GiB above its activation floor and Qwen3.5-9B 0.3 GiB above its prior peak, and 16-24 GB Macs and prompts beyond 32k were not measured. This is an availability and OOM concern (TB-007, T-029 class) and the docs say platform-admission coordination is needed. It is a self-declared follow-up, not a defect shown by this diff.

Open items:
(1) The submodule bump (libs/mlx-swift-lm 0351444e to cef66217) has no visible diff, so the MLX inference engine changes behind it are unreviewed.
(2) Check whether the production code matches invariants 8-9 (media ceiling, paged-pool sizing from max(chunk, stripe)).
(3) Check whether the activation floors and admission accounting hold for the wider chunk, and whether the env values are clamped.
